evals.prompt: I have a CSV of 30 t-shirt products with size/color variants that I need to get into our Shopify store.
evals.expected_output: Recommendation of CSV import for 20+ products, with correct multi-variant row format, required columns, and Handle uniqueness noted.
expectations: Recommends CSV import (not one-by-one GraphQL calls) given 30 products
Describes the multi-variant row format where only the first row per Handle has product-level fields
Mentions required columns (Handle, Title, variant options) and that Handle must be unique per product
